notes.Alperen Sengun: Houston is down to its thinnest backcourt of the season at Washington: Fred VanVleet is ruled out on the first night of a back-to-back and Marcus Smart is still suspended, so more of the offense runs through Sengun. Clint Capela is still out and Steven Adams is only probable in his return, and Sengun has played 37 minutes in each of his last two games.
notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: Oklahoma City is still without Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Jaylin Williams, and Ajay Mitchell is questionable with a left ankle sprain, so Gilgeous-Alexander carries nearly all of the creation. Defenses have keyed on him with the roster this thin, and he played 39 minutes in Friday's one-point loss to the Clippers.
notes.Jayson Tatum: Boston hosts a Dallas team on the second night of a back-to-back after Kyrie Irving played 37 minutes at Cleveland on Saturday. Tatum leads Boston in every category and played 38 minutes in his last game; Dallas has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Jalen Johnson: Atlanta is without Kingston Flemings (lumbar strain), Asa Newell and Mouhamed Gueye at Milwaukee, and Johnson's on-ball share is already up this season. He played 40 minutes Friday and is projected for his normal starting load.
Sacramento's lead guard has played at least 33 minutes in each of his last four games, and Maxime Raynaud remains out. Keegan Murray (illness) and Precious Achiuwa (left ankle soreness) are both questionable against Oklahoma City, which could push even more usage his way.
notes.Reed Sheppard: Fred VanVleet is ruled out and Marcus Smart is still suspended, so Sheppard is projected to start at Washington after playing 17 to 20 minutes off the bench in his last three games. He went scoreless Friday, but the open guard minutes are the reason to play him, not the last box score.
notes.Luguentz Dort: Kingston Flemings, who started Friday, is out with a lumbar strain, which opens starting minutes on the wing. Dort started three games earlier this month when Jalen Johnson was out, and he went back to about 20 minutes off the bench once the lineup was healthy.
notes.Bilal Coulibaly: Alex Sarr (illness) and Tre Johnson (low back soreness) are both questionable against Houston, and either absence pushes Coulibaly's minutes up. He has played 25 and 29 minutes off the bench in his last two games, and his value comes from steals and blocks more than scoring.
notes.Miles McBride: McBride has played 22 to 27 minutes off the bench in New York's last three games, a steady rotation role rather than a spot fill-in. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard, and Scottie Barnes is questionable with a left groin strain.
Dallas is on the second night of a back-to-back at Boston, and Kyrie Irving played 37 minutes Saturday, so watch whether Dallas eases Irving's load. Clayton played only 13 minutes Saturday with Irving on the floor that long; Dallas has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Bogdan Bogdanovic: Houston has no Fred VanVleet tonight and no Marcus Smart (suspension), so Bogdanovic is one of the few guards left behind Reed Sheppard. He has played 10 to 12 minutes in his recent games, so this is a role bump on paper, not a proven one.
notes.Malik Monk: Sacramento's bench minutes for Monk have swung from 3 to 21 in his last four games, which is the risk. Keegan Murray and Precious Achiuwa are questionable and Maxime Raynaud is out, which is the reason he could see the higher end of that range against Oklahoma City.
notes.Steven Adams: Adams is probable to return at Washington from a right soleus strain that has kept him to one game this season. Clint Capela is still out, so Houston needs a backup center behind Alperen Sengun, but his first game back may come with limited minutes.
notes.Luka Doncic: Austin Reaves is ruled out at Phoenix with a left heel bruise and Collin Sexton is questionable after needing stitches over his eye, so the Lakers lean on Doncic even more. His coach said he is fine after a late fall in his last game and expects him to play.
notes.Brandon Miller: Miller is off the injury report at the Clippers after missing two games with a hip strain. Charlotte is still without Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder (both hamstring strains), so he returns to a bigger share of the offense.
notes.Kyrie Irving: Irving played 37 minutes Saturday at Cleveland, scoring 20 of his 34 in the third quarter, and Dallas now plays at Boston on the second night of the back-to-back. Dallas has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Quentin Grimes: Grimes is listed available at Phoenix after missing two games with a right finger sprain, and he will play with a splint. With Austin Reaves out, there are guard minutes open next to Luka Doncic.
notes.Scottie Barnes: Barnes is questionable against New York with a left groin strain, and Kawhi Leonard is ruled out again. If Barnes sits, Toronto loses its top two forwards.
